summary: Both bundled fixes fully match the saved plan. Part A (#469): MonitorConfig.require_ci (default True, documented), PRStatus.no_checks_observed (safe default False, documented), authoritative population in github_client (rollup None or contexts.totalCount==0, with totalCount added to the GraphQL query) and bitbucket_client (not statuses from the fully-paginated commit-statuses list), decide() gate-6 bypass gated on `not require_ci and no_checks_observed` with a semantics comment, ProfileMonitor.require_ci, and wiring at release_pr_monitor (both builders) and the worker _pr_monitor_factory; runner.py:103 left intentionally default-only. Tests cover require_ci=False+no-checks+clean->Merge() (point-7 proof), UNKNOWN->WaitForCI(unknown), checks-present->WaitForCI(pending), FAILURE->ReportCiFailure, the require_ci=True regression, both clients setting the signal for 0 and >=1 checks, fetch-failure raising ForgeClientError (no mergeable no-checks status), profile schema default/parse, and profile->runtime wiring at every site (worker factory via a real parsed WorkspaceProfile, both builders). Part B (#468): a single _resolve_handoff_pr_number helper (metadata.number or _extract_pr_number(metadata.url)) reused at all four handoff sites, GitHub unchanged; tests cover BitBucket /pull-requests/7 with trailing slash, ?query and #frag -> 7, GitHub /pull/7 -> 7 regression, and malformed -> None plus handoff-level resolution. openapi.json drift regenerated in the commit; no new reason codes. All new branches have direct tests (no coverage-theater). Non-goals respected (no row backfill, no rejected alternatives, no x-token-auth, no GitHub number-behavior change).
